name: @pilihpendidikan/jobs-cli
description: Turborepo shim for the pilih-jobs Python CLI (uv project; see README.md)

scripts.test: sh ../../scripts/require-uv.sh && uv run pytest -m "not e2e and not live and not browser"
scripts.lint: sh ../../scripts/require-uv.sh && uv run ruff check src tests scripts && uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts && uv run lint-imports
scripts.audit: sh ../../scripts/require-uv.sh && uv export --frozen --format requirements-txt --no-emit-project --all-groups --quiet | uv run --frozen pip-audit --strict --disable-pip --progress-spinner off -r /dev/stdin
